restaurantName: The Coral Room at The Bloomsbury
bio: Why not treat yourself to a luxurious Afternoon Tea experience in stylish surroundings at The Coral Room? Their Afternoon Tea menu is inspired by quintessential classics.  The sophisticated Coral Room is designed in collaboration with the acclaimed Martin Brudnizki and features a 1920's style decor with vibrant coral coloured walls, glass chandeliers and a stunning marble bar centrepiece.  Set on the edge of Soho, this neo Georgian Grade II listed building is ideally located just a short walk away from the British Museum and Tottenham Court Road Tube station.
pageTitle: The Coral Room at The Bloomsbury
